title: Practice: choose how a job runs unattended or on a rhythm (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 every job of the bank gets its mechanism its reason and its interval
cases.says: Each of the fourteen jobs of the page's bank gets its mechanism, its reason code and its interval

cases.id: e1 a pipeline job is a headless run whatever else is true
cases.says: A pipeline job is a headless run whatever else is true

cases.id: e2 a condition or a background command decides before an event and an event is watched unless it must run unattended
cases.says: A condition or a background command decides before an event, and an event is watched unless it must run unattended

cases.id: e3 a one off job fires in the session unless the machine is off or the session is closed
cases.says: A one-off job fires in the session unless the machine is off or the session is closed

cases.id: e4 a cloud schedule is refused below one hour and a desktop schedule below one minute
cases.says: A cloud schedule is refused below one hour and a desktop schedule below one minute

cases.id: e5 a fixed loop rounds seconds up to whole minutes and no interval means self paced
cases.says: A fixed loop rounds seconds up to whole minutes, and no interval means self-paced

cases.id: e6 a recurring loop lasts seven days so a longer job needs a durable home
cases.says: A recurring loop lasts seven days, so a longer job needs a durable home

cases.id: e7 an unknown value is an error a cloud run cannot see local files and a missing key takes its default
cases.says: An unknown value is an error, a cloud run cannot see local files, and a missing key takes its default
